summary: Import-time dropper fetches and executes attacker-controlled native binary
details: On require of the package, index.js loads _shim.js which selects a platform-specific binary from a list of string-split-obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts (reassembled at runtime, e.g. oob-worker.cf99-9b3.workers.dev), with a DNS-TXT chunked-base64 fallback across wel1.ru subdomains (sdk.dl.wel1.ru, ext.dl.wel1.ru, pkg.dl.wel1.ru, net.dl.wel1.ru; count served at c.<domain>, parts at N.<domain>). The retrieved payload is written to /tmp or %TEMP% under cover names resembling system tooling (dotnet_diag_*.exe,.cache_*), chmodded 0755 on POSIX, and spawned detached via spawn("/bin/sh",["-c", path+" &"],{detached:true}) or spawn("cmd",...) on Windows. The destinations are obfuscated, unrelated to any legitimate publisher, and the executed bytes are attacker-controlled.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
